source_class: NRL.com official Finals Week 1 roster and official NRL player profiles
rule: Raw profile facts are preserved separately from MAYHEM inference. Unpublished fields are FIELD_NOT_PUBLISHED. Derived trends identify genuine rounds used and do not establish causation.

players.trend_note: Rounds 23 and 24 were 80-minute centre appearances with 107 and 100 running metres; Round 26 was a 34-minute wing appearance with 45 running metres. This establishes a verified late-season centre-to-wing role transition and workload variation only; no causal explanation is inferred.
players.team_effect: Named finals wing baseline enriched with verified recent role transition; return to named side retained as availability context without standalone confidence adjustment.

players.trend_note: Rounds 23, 24, 26 and 27 show continuous 80-minute five-eighth deployment. Recorded kicking metres were 294, 267, 241 and 56. This establishes role continuity with a sharp Round 27 reduction in recorded kicking burden; no causal explanation is inferred.
players.team_effect: Role-critical five-eighth and kicking baseline enriched; no standalone confidence adjustment.

players.trend_note: Round 20 and the post-return Rounds 26-27 were 80-minute halfback appearances. Recorded kicking metres were 274, 40 and 116; running metres were 88, 52 and 81. Official NRL reporting records his Round 26 return after four games out with an ankle injury. This establishes return state and role continuity only; no medical inference or causal performance claim is made.
players.team_effect: Role-critical halfback/playmaking baseline enriched; return-from-injury state is carried as continuity uncertainty without standalone confidence uplift.
